title: nan
authors: Yang C.; Sun Z.; Bu Y.; Liu B.; Li X.
key_contribution: Presents a road similarity-based BEV-satellite image matching algorithm fused with LiDAR-inertial odometry and particle filtering for UGV localization in GNSS-denied off-road environments over 10 km.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
